title: Verify duplicate settlement descriptions are not used for the same merchant
sqlValidation:
SELECT merchantId, description, COUNT(*) AS duplicateCount
FROM dbo.Settlements
GROUP BY merchantId, description
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
